findings.evidence: The item states that one Rayleigh-quotient iteration step can be started from x(t) and then treats t=0 as having next slope 0, but def-rayleigh-quotient-iteration defines the step only when A-mu(t)I is invertible; here mu(0)=2, so A-mu(0)I=diag(0,-1) is singular.
